messages:
Ava (PM): FYI sprint got compressed by a week. We need a quick scope triage for MVP vs v1; also Nora says pilot customer BetaCorp wants embedding cache + 100ms tail-latency SLA for search. Can we do both?
Nora (Sales): BetaCorp is committed but SLA is a gating item. They said embeddings cache + TTL + a simple admin toggle would be enough for pilot.
Marcus (Eng): embedding cache is mostly a redis-backed layer + invalidation hooks. estimate: 3 dev-days + 1 infra day. 100ms tail for search is harder; depends on model choice & batching.
Priya (Eng-Infra): infra note: to hit 100ms p95 for embedding-based search we need hot cache + colocated nearest-neighbor index (faiss on local SSD) and limits on batch windows. provisioning + tuning ~5 infra-days. Could we scope SLA to pilot traffic?
Lina (Design): for admin UI we can ship a tiny toggle and TTL dropdown (30/90/180d). low design cost. messaging in-app about eventual consistency is needed.
Zoë (QA): embedding cache correctness + staleness tests + perf test -> ~2 QA days. Need a small promptset for search queries.
Ava (PM): options: 1) Prioritize cache + limited SLA for pilot only (traffic cap) and push broad SLA + multi-region perf to v1. 2) Defer cache to v1 and promise workaround (longer responses) to BetaCorp. 3) Quick ops-assisted cache (managed TTLs) for pilot. Thoughts?
Marcus (Eng): Prefer 1 with traffic cap. We can implement cache + local ANN with feature flag. If BetaCorp agrees to a 100 qps cap for pilot, it's feasible.
Priya (Eng-Infra): agree on traffic-cap SLA window. I'll stand up faiss nodes and a small hot-tier. Need to add alert: cache-miss rate > 20% -> degrade SLA.
Nora (Sales): BetaCorp OK with 100 qps cap during pilot. They want a rollback plan if perf regresses.
Ava (PM): decision: accept option 1. MVP will include embedding cache (feature-flagged), admin TTL toggle (basic UI), and a pilot-scoped 100ms p95 SLA capped at 100 qps. Broad SLA and autoscaling for larger tenants -> v1.
Marcus (Eng): will branch `feat/embed-cache-pilot`, add feature flag + fallback to cold path.
Lina (Design): will push a minimal TTL toggle mock and in-app note: "Pilot mode: limited admin controls".
Zoë (QA): scheduling correctness + perf runs. ETA 3 days for green.
infra-bot: faiss cluster provision requested: 2 nodes, SSD, zone us-west-2a.
Priya (Eng-Infra): provisioning now; will post infra PR with cost delta.
Ava (PM): I'll update milestone tracker, tag SLA as pilot-only, and notify BetaCorp + sales. Add any additional risks here.
Marcus (Eng): risk: cold-path searches may spike cost; track token + compute per-search.
Priya (Eng-Infra): risk: faiss memory fragmentation at high churn; add eviction stats.
Ava (PM): noted. closing thread 44d
thread_preview: Sprint compressed; team agrees to ship embedding cache + pilot-scoped 100ms p95 SLA with traffic cap; broad SLA and autoscaling deferred to v1.
